correctness.rationale: Exact Lucas/Fine product, cyclic two-carry recursion, and finite-cutoff variance formula yield a fixed-shift rational Pearson kernel. Symbolic factorizations prove strict inequalities for all odd primes and all digit patterns, including unique first and second tiers; a contracting carry matrix yields positive coefficients with infimum zero. The bundled standard-library exact checker independently compares modular Pascal rows, cyclic mixed moments, and rational bounds for p=3,5,7,11; finite tests are supporting evidence, not a universal proof.

value.rationale: For the well-studied natural number-theoretic row-count statistic, this classifies the two sharp global dependence tiers with exact equality shifts at every odd prime, and supplies a rational recursion for arbitrary fixed shifts and a zero-infimum construction. These are motivated structural refinements of marginal Pascal-row enumeration, not ad hoc finite data or renaming.
